meta.audit: WS-30 adversarial audit: Limitless 5-min ETH/BTC up/down, Chainlink 60s-TWAP resolution

resolution_mechanics.feed: ETH/USD TWAP-60s, Chainlink Data Streams feedId 0x0002fbf9f58ef89c933853ee095593
resolution_mechanics.rule: Up iff TWAP60(close) >= TWAP60(open) [Price to Beat = metadata.openPrice, published at market creation]
resolution_mechanics.oracle_public_access: Limitless exposes the TWAP series itself via GET /markets/{slug}/oracle-candles (source=chainlink, 1m candles); raw stream via api.dataengine.chain.link requires Chainlink Data Streams credentials

reproducibility_test.method: sign(TWAP60(end) - TWAP60(open)) both sides from Binance 1s, vs actual winningOutcomeIndex
reproducibility_test.conclusion: documented rule confirmed; no misresolutions detected in sample

chainlink_vs_binance_basis.implication: basis (12.5 bps) exceeds median resolution margin (5.7 bps): a bot computing TWAP state from CEX data trades noise; real Chainlink stream access is mandatory

endgame_price_behavior_eth.converged_and_correct: 238/238 windows where |p-0.5|>=0.45 at any point resolved in the implied direction (0 wrong calls)
endgame_price_behavior_eth.interpretation: Books that matter are >=0.95/<0.05 by T-60 and always right; non-converged windows are dead/empty books at stale 0.5, not free optionality

live_orderbook_trace.final_25s: best ask degrades 0.126 -> 0.062, ask depth shrinks to $20
live_orderbook_trace.note: observed 0.808/0.192-type quotes are one-sided books, not two-sided probabilities

twap_flip_simulation_binance_proxy.method: ETHUSDT 1s closes; strike=mean(t-60..t at window open), close=mean(last 60s); sign-flip = sign(TWAP60@T-x - strike) != outcome

perfect_knowledge_upper_bound.scenario: buy winning side at T-120 hist mid, $10 stake, fee 5%(1-p)
perfect_knowledge_upper_bound.caveat: requires literal knowledge of the future; realistic TWAP-state bot has no residual edge because mid-band prices calibrate fairly

fees_new_venues.taker: 5% x (1-price) of USDC notional both sides
